source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: The multi-year RDB extension covers the BAL Playoffs and Finals in 2024, 2026 and 2028, so the league-wide Visit Rwanda branding on BAL team uniforms was in force for the 2026 season, Dar City's first. The 17 March 2026 BAL release (bal.nba.com, Puma announcement) confirms the Rwanda Development Board was still a Foundational Partner in the 2026 season.

source.name: The BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as league's official outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms, warm-up gear, practice wear, accessories
source.note: League-wide kit outfitter from the 2026 season: PUMA makes the game uniforms of all 12 BAL teams, including Dar City. Kit maker, not a bought shirt slot.

summary: League-controlled branding only: PUMA is the BAL's official outfitter from the 2026 season and Visit Rwanda is carried on BAL team uniforms league-wide. Dar City made its BAL debut in 2026 (announced by the league on 26 February 2026). No club-level shirt sponsor found.
